title: rpm.gateway_config.v1
description: Per-bed clinical configuration for an ICU bedside gateway, published RETAINED on rpm/v1/dev/{gateway}/config so the gateway receives the current state on every (re)connect. Carries no patient identifiers: beds are keyed by monitor device id.

spo2_scale.description: NEWS2 SpO2 scale; 2 for hypercapnic respiratory failure (target 88-92%)

gcs_baseline.description: Best GCS this ICU episode as known to the cloud: the NEWS2 consciousness baseline, so a gateway that joins mid-episode still recognises new confusion
